description: Source code for a Qt-based graphical configuration tool (qconf), including classes for UI components, settings management, and main application logic.

classes.name: ConfigMainWindow
classes.description: Main application window managing the overall UI and user interactions.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: Handles persistent application settings storage and retrieval.

classes.name: ConfigItem
classes.description: Represents individual configuration options in the UI.

classes.name: ConfigItemDelegate
classes.description: Custom delegate for editing ConfigItem data in views.

classes.name: ConfigList
classes.description: Widget displaying a list/tree of configuration options.

classes.name: ConfigInfoView
classes.description: Displays detailed information about selected configuration symbols or menus.

classes.name: ConfigSearchWindow
classes.description: Provides a UI for searching configuration options.

methods.name: updateMenu
methods.description: Updates the display of a menu entry based on its current state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Constructs a menu entry object.

methods.name: testUpdateMenu
methods.description: Updates menu display if the menu has changed.

methods.name: createEditor
methods.description: Creates an editor widget for in-place editing of configuration data.

methods.name: setModelData
methods.description: Commits data from editor widget to the model.

methods.name: reinit
methods.description: Reinitializes the configuration list display.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Saves current UI state to persistent settings.

methods.name: setOptionMode
methods.description: Sets the display mode for options (normal, all, prompt).

methods.name: findConfigItem
methods.description: Finds a ConfigItem associated with a specific menu.

methods.name: updateSelection
methods.description: Updates the UI based on current selection.

methods.name: updateList
methods.description: Refreshes the list of configuration options.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a configuration item.

methods.name: changeValue
methods.description: Toggles or changes the value of a configuration item.

methods.name: setRootMenu
methods.description: Sets the root menu for the configuration list.

methods.name: setParentMenu
methods.description: Navigates to the parent menu.

methods.name: updateMenuList
methods.description: Updates child menu entries in the UI.

methods.name: keyPressEvent
methods.description: Handles key press events for navigation and editing.

methods.name: mousePressEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse press events.

methods.name: mouseReleaseEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse release events.

methods.name: mouseMoveEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse move events.

methods.name: mouseDoubleClickEvent
methods.description: Handles double-click events.

methods.name: focusInEvent
methods.description: Handles focus-in events.

methods.name: contextMenuEvent
methods.description: Displays context menu.

methods.name: setShowName
methods.description: Toggles display of option names.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Saves window and UI state.

methods.name: conf_changed
methods.description: Updates UI based on configuration change state.

methods.name: fixup_rootmenu
methods.description: Ensures root menu flags are correctly set.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays command-line usage information.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializes and runs the Qt app.
